description: This file implements the TavusVideoService class, a Python module for managing avatar-based video generation through the Tavus streaming API. It handles session setup, participant video and audio handling, frame processing, and integration with external Tavus transport and callback objects. The service manages WebRTC-like participant streams, audio resampling, and task scheduling, providing key features for real-time video and audio proxying with Tavus.

classes.name: TavusVideoService
classes.description: A service class for managing avatar video generation through Tavus, including participant session handling, frame processing, and communication with Tavus's streaming API.

methods.name: None __init__( self, *, api_key: str, replica_id: str, persona_id: str = "pipecat-stream", session: aiohttp.ClientSession, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the TavusVideoService with API credentials, session, and configuration.

methods.name: setup(self, setup: FrameProcessorSetup)
methods.description: Sets up the Tavus client and callback handlers.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disconnects Tavus client.

methods.name: _on_participant_left(self, participant, reason)
methods.description: Handles participant leaving event, logs participant ID and reason.

methods.name: _on_participant_joined(self, participant)
methods.description: Handles participant joining, initiates capture of participant video and audio streams.

methods.name: _on_participant_video_frame( self, participant_id: str, video_frame: VideoFrame, video_source: str )
methods.description: Processes incoming participant video frames and pushes them into the media pipeline.

methods.name: _on_participant_audio_data( self, participant_id: str, audio: AudioData, audio_source: str )
methods.description: Processes incoming participant audio data and pushes it into the pipeline.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates if the service can generate processing metrics.

methods.name: str get_persona_name(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the current persona name from Tavus.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the video service, initializes transmission, and registers audio destination.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the service and ends the current conversation.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels the service operation and ends the conversation.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes various frame types, managing interruptions, TTS, and transport readiness.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions(self)
methods.description: Handles interruptions by resetting send tasks and notifying Tavus.

methods.name: _create_send_task(self)
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task for sending audio frames.

methods.name: _cancel_send_task(self)
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing send audio task.

methods.name: _handle_audio_frame(self, frame: OutputAudioRawFrame)
methods.description: Buffers and resamples outgoing audio frames, enqueueing chunks for sending.

methods.name: _send_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Continuously fetches audio frames from the queue and writes them to Tavus client.
